title: Broad-Spectrum Antimicrobial Activity and Low Cytotoxicity against Human Cells of a Peptide Derived from Bovine α(S1)-Casein.
tools_attempted: rg over XML/PDF extracted text for activity/toxicity/mechanism phrases
summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework recovered the Table 3 salt MIC matrix, corrected peptide/entity assignment for activity rows, reconciled linked database rows against primary source locators, and replaced placeholder mechanism notes with bounded direct-assay mechanism evidence.
adjudication_summary: The previous open ticket is closed only because local XML/PDF/database evidence supports the owned worker-2/4/6 repairs; unresolved database overreach is preserved as caution-level source_conflict rather than normalized away.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All linked database rows were reopened from packet JSONL and assigned source_verified or source_conflict with primary-source/table/database locators; unsupported antifungal and serovar labels remain conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 MIC/MHC rows, text-supported hemolysis/cytotoxicity values, and the complete Table 3 salt MIC matrix were extracted with peptide entity, raw value, unit, target, conditions, and source locator.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism claims are limited to direct membrane/permeability assays and microscopy supported by XML sections, methods, and figure captions; nucleic-acid binding is not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: No local supplementary assets exist in the packet; source review used XML, PDF text, OA package members/figures, and linked database snapshots.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 16 linked database rows retain source_conflict because the database row exceeds or conflicts with primary-paper evidence.
Packet supplementary_index.json and supplementary_tables.json contain zero supplementary assets/tables; XML, PDF text, OA package members, figures, and linked database snapshots were used instead.
Mechanism and toxicity curves were not digitized beyond exact values reported in XML/PDF text; qualitative/direct-assay claims are bounded to local text and figure locators.
